name: opening_range_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the first 15 minutes (09:15–09:30) are the overnight information absorption window where FII pre-open order imbalances, SGX Nifty cues, and domestic institutional adjustments settle into resting limit orders that define the opening range. The OR high and OR low become self-fulfilling algorithmic reference levels — systematic trend-followers, options market makers delta-hedging, and TWAP algos all anchor their trigger conditions to these levels. When NIFTY sustains 3 consecutive 5-second closes above the OR high (15 seconds of unbroken price action), buy-side institutional flow has demonstrably overwhelmed the supply cluster at the OR high and triggered stop-loss cascades from range-bound players, initiating a mechanical momentum burst.
core_signal_oneliner: 15-minute opening range breakout with 3-bar (15s) sustained close persistence above/below OR boundary, with VIX < 25 filter
